changes.note: now the "sticky" module can be disabled with the --without-http_upstream_sticky_module configure option; the --without-http_upstream_sticky configure option is deprecated.
now the "keepalive" directive in the "upstream" block is enabled by default.
now ngx_http_proxy_module supports keepalive by default; the default value for "proxy_http_version" is "1.1"; the "Connection" proxy header is not sent by default anymore.
now TLSv1.3 certificate compression is disabled by default.
now TLSv1 and TLSv1.1 protocols are disabled by default.
HTTP/2 server push support has been removed.
the deprecated "ssl" directive is not supported anymore.
now TLSv1.3 protocol is enabled by default.
now nginx is built with the PCRE2 library by default.
support for NPN instead of ALPN to establish HTTP/2 connections has been removed.

connections handling in HTTP/2 has been changed to better match HTTP/1.x; the "http2_recv_timeout", "http2_idle_timeout", and "http2_max_requests" directives have been removed, the "keepalive_timeout" and "keepalive_requests" directives should be used instead.
the "http2_max_field_size" and "http2_max_header_size" directives have been removed, the "large_client_header_buffers" directive should be used instead.
the "ssl" directive is deprecated; the "ssl" parameter of the "listen" directive should be used instead.
the --with-ipv6 configure option was removed, now IPv6 support is configured automatically.
now the "accept_mutex" directive is turned off by default.

non-idempotent requests (POST, LOCK, PATCH) are no longer passed to the next server by default if a request has been sent to a backend; the "non_idempotent" parameter of the "proxy_next_upstream" directive explicitly allows retrying such requests.
now the "output_buffers" directive uses two buffers by default.
now SSLv3 protocol is disabled by default.
some long deprecated directives are not supported anymore.
obsolete aio and rtsig event methods have been removed.
the "sendfile" parameter of the "aio" directive is deprecated; now nginx automatically uses AIO to pre-load data for sendfile if both "aio" and "sendfile" directives are used.
the deprecated "limit_zone" directive is not supported anymore.
now nginx assumes HTTP/1.0 by default if it is not able to detect protocol reliably.
a compiler with name "cc" is now used by default.
the "ipv6only" parameter is now turned on by default for listening IPv6 sockets.
keepalive connections are no longer disabled for Safari by default.
the ngx_http_limit_zone_module was renamed to the ngx_http_limit_conn_module.
now nginx does not cache by default backend responses, if they have a "Set-Cookie" header line.
now SSLv2 protocol is disabled by default.
now ngx_http_charset_module does not work by default with text/css MIME type.
now ngx_http_charset_module works by default with following MIME types: text/html, text/css, text/xml, text/plain, text/vnd.wap.wml, application/x-javascript, and application/rss+xml.
some long deprecated directives are not supported anymore.
now by default the rtsig method is not built on Linux 2.6.18+.
the "open_file_cache_retest" directive was renamed to the "open_file_cache_valid".
now by default the "echo" SSI command uses entity encoding.
the method $r->rflush of ngx_http_perl_module was renamed to the $r->flush.
the "imap" and "auth" directives were renamed to the "mail" and "pop3_auth" directives.
the parameters in the "%name" form in the "log_format" directive are not supported anymore.

the "proxy_upstream_max_fails", "proxy_upstream_fail_timeout", "fastcgi_upstream_max_fails", "fastcgi_upstream_fail_timeout", "memcached_upstream_max_fails", and "memcached_upstream_fail_timeout" directives are not supported anymore.
now the "tcp_nodelay" directive is turned on by default.
the "proxy_redirect_errors" and "fastcgi_redirect_errors" directives was renamed to the "proxy_intercept_errors" and "fastcgi_intercept_errors" directives.
now the "\" escape symbol in the "\"" and "\'" pairs in the SSI command is always removed.
the "optimize_host_names" directive was renamed to the "optimize_server_names".
the "proxy_header_buffer_size" and "fastcgi_header_buffer_size" directives was renamed to the "proxy_buffer_size" and "fastcgi_buffer_size" directives.
the "bl" and "af" parameters of the "listen" directive was renamed to the "backlog" and "accept_filter".
a variable name must be declared as "$name" in the "geo" directive. The previous variant without "$" is still supported, but will be removed soon.
the directory name for the temporary files with the client request body is specified by directive client_body_temp_path, by default it is <prefix>/client_body_temp.
